proved_claims.name: two-step retained-palette theorem
proved_claims.statement: At a full-response independent triple S={s0,s1,s2}, put B=N_complement(G)(x), Bi=B intersect N_complement(G)(si), and P(b)={i:{x,si,b} is retained}. Then the Bi are disjoint, |P(b)|>=2, b in Bq implies q in P(b), and i in P(b) implies b has no complement neighbor in Bi. Hence every Bi is independent and every B-vertex has complement neighbors in at most one root spoke.

proved_claims.name: two-spoke component theorem
proved_claims.statement: If H[B] has no isolated vertex and every B-vertex belongs to a root spoke, every connected component of H[B] uses exactly two spoke classes, which are its bipartition sides. Each component therefore has a canonical local two-color palette compatible with the root triangle.

proved_claims.name: exact first-layer boundary
proved_claims.statement: The C-123 and C-128 controls both fail the new second-attack condition. In C-128, B8={1,5} contains a complement edge, Q(1)={4}, Q(5)={0}, and four root-successor/physical-inactive attack pairs have no legal dominating response.
